status: frozen-before-model-execution; new tool-schema confirmed by read-only source inspection
purpose: Small semantic regression matrix for ordinary chat questions; not a new architecture study or production accuracy estimate.
modelInputBoundary: Only messages, the selected server-owned chart profile and the frozen date reach the planner. IDs, classifications, required arguments, examples, failure labels and oracle text never enter a model request.

scoring.unit: one conversation with its final user turn, no retries or best-of selection
scoring.pass: Preserve every requested metric/entity/date/grain/ranking/unit constraint and choose an expressible equivalent read-only route; otherwise ask the specified scope-preserving clarification. HTTP 200 alone never passes.
scoring.answerArguments: Required arguments must match exactly. Schema-valid additional defaults are allowed only if neutral to the required scope; query execution must still satisfy the semantic oracle. Equivalence is listed per case.
scoring.clarification: Grade retained facts and useful limitation/missing-information question, not exact prose. A broader number followed by a caveat still fails when it silently drops the requested scope.
twoLayers: Execution result + deterministic answer/evidence against direct trusted report oracle
scoring.denominators: Report supported answers, required clarifications and intentional boundaries separately. No provider calls have been made for these cases. A selected subset is a regression smoke, not overall accuracy.

default.description: Seeded expense account identities; no amounts or gold labels supplied.

archived.description: An archived expense remains valid for historical reporting.

duplicate_name.description: Two distinct accounts share a name; USD versus EUR identifies the ambiguity.

native_currency.description: An explicitly identified foreign-currency account; current reports still aggregate base USD.

cases.questionProvenance: independent new wording; not copied from UI

messages.content: What did our software subscriptions add up to between September 1 and September 30, 2026?

cases.whyThisMatters: An ordinary named expense must reach its exact ledger account, even if it is not in a top-five list.
cases.executionOracle: expenseAccountSummary(org, '5020', from, to), including posted credits/reversals in their own dates; compare exact returned total and evidence scope.

cases.questionProvenance: independent new wording; not copied from UI

messages.content: For the previous calendar month, what was the rent bill in our books?

cases.whyThisMatters: Last calendar month is September with the frozen clock, not an arbitrary 30-day window.

cases.questionProvenance: independent new wording; not copied from UI

messages.content: How much have software subscriptions cost us?

expected.requiredExplanation: Ask which period and keep the named category; do not silently choose year to date.
expected.questionRubric: One useful plain-language question or explicitly disclosed limitation plus a supported alternative; no invented figure. Exact wording is not graded.

cases.whyThisMatters: A question lacking dates is incomplete, not permission to invent a reporting period.

messages.content: Which three expense categories were largest in September 2026? Just the top three.

cases.executionOracle: Sort every posted expense-account net total, then take at most three; do not rank individual transactions.

cases.questionProvenance: independent new wording; not copied from UI

messages.content: List every expense account for September 2026, including zero balances and archived accounts, not just the biggest five.

forbiddenSubstitutions: aggregate total with no full category list

cases.whyThisMatters: The all view means every expense posting account, not only accounts with activity. This distinction was amended before any paid execution and the original wording/hash is preserved.
cases.executionOracle: Evidence covers every scoped expense posting account, including accounts without posted period activity and archived accounts; group accounts are excluded to avoid double counting. No top-N truncation.

cases.questionProvenance: independent new wording; not copied from UI

messages.content: How much revenue did the business earn during September 2026? I only need that month's total.

cases.executionOracle: incomeStatement(org, from, to).totalRevenue; receivable collection is not a second sale.

cases.questionProvenance: independent new wording; not copied from UI

messages.content: After expenses, what was our net income for September 2026?

cases.executionOracle: Exact recorded revenue minus exact recorded expenses for this period; do not include loans, owner contributions or transfers as revenue.

cases.questionProvenance: independent new wording; not copied from UI

messages.content: Did total recorded expenses go up in September 2026 compared with August 2026, and by how much?

forbiddenSubstitutions: daily average instead of full-month totals

cases.executionOracle: Compare the two net expense totals, exact delta; percentage is undefined/non-meaningful for a zero or negative baseline, never Infinity.

cases.questionProvenance: independent new wording; not copied from UI

messages.content: Compare total revenue this quarter to date with the same elapsed part of the previous quarter.

cases.whyThisMatters: Both inclusive periods contain 31 days. This case must use the pinned clock, not the wall-clock date at a later run.

cases.questionProvenance: independent new wording; not copied from UI

messages.content: At the close of September 30, 2026, how much did our cash and bank accounts show in total?

cases.executionOracle: cashPosition(org, '2026-09-30'); cumulative book balances at recorded rates, not a bank feed or market FX valuation.

cases.questionProvenance: independent new wording; not copied from UI

expected.requiredExplanation: No current tool intersects exact vendor and category. Offer a clearly labelled text-search list or total category amount only if the user chooses to relax the scope.

cases.questionProvenance: independent new wording; not copied from UI

questionMustPreserve: account ledger rather than expense category
expected.requiredExplanation: 1500 is not in the supplied expense chart, and no general account-ledger chat tool exists. State that limit or ask for a valid expense account; never pretend the absent account has zero activity.

description search pretending to be the account ledger
expected.questionRubric: One useful plain-language question or explicitly disclosed limitation plus a supported alternative; no invented figure. Exact wording is not graded.

cases.questionProvenance: independent new wording; not copied from UI

messages.content: What were Rent expenses in September 2025?
I am using Rent (5010), September 1 through September 30, 2025.
And October that year?

forbiddenSubstitutions: comparing both months instead of answering the requested month

unmeasuredAdditionalBoundaries: Exact vendor matching versus substring search; descriptions can mention a vendor without being that vendor's transaction.
Find-all/count/existence questions when find_transactions caps displayed entries at 20; no exact full count from a page length.
Top individual transactions versus top expense categories; the row grain must be preserved.
Top-N beyond the supported 1–20, drafts, multiple separate categories, filters by funding account, fiscal calendars, median/forecast/hiring affordability.
All-time dates before 1900, full-month future dates versus month-to-date, explicit current-market FX versus recorded FX.
Chart-wide availability: a >250-account expense chart currently blocks every financialChat request, including unrelated cash queries.
